bio.p1: I'm Emilio Luna, a 4 years of experience Backend Developer and Tech Leader working at the Airport Security Police. My day-to-day sits at the intersection of software engineering and high-stakes operations, where reliability isn't optional.
bio.p2: I enjoy building projects that make a real difference for people: from AI-powered recognition systems to real-time communication tools and productivity apps.
bio.p3: Whether I'm designing an API, architecting a container stack, or prototyping a desktop app, I bring the same mindset: build it right, make it count.
bio.p4: Outside work I keep experimenting: if I imagine something I could build, I build it.
